brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full base with hex-bin-full (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) forms enclosed storage volume, capped on all 6 side faces (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) and locked.

cover:0,0,0;full;top fitted on bin top face; configurator confirms covers have magnets fitted by default – setCoverMagnets on:true returned ALREADY_FITTED/NO_CHANGE meaning magnets are present to hold lid shut.

finish.summary: Single-cell storage box built from full base + full-height bin + full top cover. Cover retains its factory magnets (verified by attempted setCoverMagnets returning already-fitted), providing magnetic lid closure. Open faces capped and joints locked, mesh clear.

events.text: A magnetic-closing storage box — I'll assemble your lidded box.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A joint bolt fastens the wall between two touching bases. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: You've got a single base ready — now I'll build it into a magnet-sealed box with a lidded compartment.

outcomes.message: that changes nothing: the cover already has its magnets in (a cover has them unless taken out). on: false (details.toChange) would take them out.

result.note: These ops were refused ALREADY_FITTED or NO_CHANGE (that state already holds), so the batch was applied again without them.

events.text: The lid's magnetic catch is in place — now I'll seal the edges and verify the finished storage box.
